raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 13 (ingest 2026-01-18) sends amount values with a leading '$' currency symbol (e.g. '$29.57'), and the strict DECIMAL cast in silver_transactions fails on them. Every row is USD and the values are on the same scale as the other batches, so the symbol is only a formatting change and removing it gives the correct amounts.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(regexp_replace(trim(CAST(amount AS VARCHAR)), '^\\$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
